input: How does WhatsApp voice calling infrastructure work?
content:
# MOCK research report (fixture, not a real research result)

This deterministic fixture stands in for a Tavily Deep Research report so the pipeline can run without provider calls. Its statements are demonstration data and are not verified findings about WhatsApp.

## Call setup
A signaling exchange sets up the call before any audio flows.

## Media
Audio is compressed by a codec and sent as small packets, protected by end-to-end encryption. Relay servers can forward packets when a direct path is blocked.

## Adaptation
Apps adapt bitrate and conceal packet loss when networks degrade.

## Unknowns
Exact codecs, server regions and vendors are not documented here.
